content: So, Misaki, you're from Japan, right?
Yes, I'm from Akita, the northern Japan.
There are a lot of mountains. And you can actually see colors changing on them in the fall.
Yeah, in my home, Yashima town, there are only 6,000 people. But there is an amazing waterfall which I consider to be the best in Japan, really tall and wide.
Cool. So when is the last time you went home?
7 days ago. My parents still live there.
